senses.gloss: (b. h. טֹרַח; טָרַח)toil, labor, trouble, painstaking preparations.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 153a:6">Sabb. 153ᵃ</cite> <he>כלום … בלא ט׳</he> is there a banquet without visible preparation?; (<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:8">Koh. R. to IX, 8</cite> <cite ref="E00323"><he>הֶטְרֵחַ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Moed Katan 8b:11">M. Kat. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני הט׳</he> on account of the labor (connected with preparing the wedding).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 10:4:2">Y. Pes. X, 37ᵈ</cite> top <he>מה הט׳ … מטריחים וכ׳</he> what is all that trouble for to which you put us &c.?; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="I00749"><he>טָרְחוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:5">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>כמה ט׳ טרח וכ׳</he> to how much trouble did the host go &c.; (Y. ib. IX, 13ᶜ <he>כמה טורח</he>).
Lev. R. s. 1 משה עסוק בט׳ וכ׳ Moses (like an agoranomos) was engaged in the (dietary) affairs of Israel.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94:5">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> <he>ט׳ נפש אחת</he> the troubles of providing for one soul.—V. <cite ref="I00749"><he>טַרְחוּת</he></cite> a. <cite ref="I00748"><he>טִרְחָא</he></cite>.
